rationale: No public fMRI dataset is simultaneously (a) INDEPENDENT of the prior program (C3XC/C3XD/C3XDR/C3XDR-R1/C3XAT/C3XAT-R1) and (b) structurally sufficient for the C3XAT replication estimand (>=50 distinct naturalistic imagery identities repeated across >=4-5 independent imagery units, matched perception with full identity correspondence, known cue/post-video timing, >=6 eligible subjects). All structurally-capable imagery datasets are KamitaniLab-lineage (GOD used in C3XB; Mind Captioning is C3XAT; shared participant pool) or NSD-Imagery (used in C3) -> NOT_INDEPENDENT. All independent imagery datasets are structurally insufficient (SemReps-8K: 3 imagery identities; THINGS-fMRI/BOLD5000/NOD: perception-only).
next: proceed to a prospective acquisition protocol (Phase G) + precision planning (Phase F) + prospective spatial-specificity design (Phase I); NO real neural outcome executed.
